confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or named sources were checked. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel rates vary widely by neighbourhood, and July is off-peak monsoon season, so accommodation is less certain. Cocktail and wine are weaker and set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.9x, wine glass about 1.8x). Local prices were reasoned in INR at roughly 90 per USD, not a live rate. The 0.6961 FX value was reported in search summaries attributed to RBA exchange-rate pages; I could not open the RBA page or find a 14 October 2026 observation, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as an anchor base. The basis is South Asian metro pricing, estimated from general knowledge of ordinary Mumbai venues rather than luxury or tourist-trap prices. Cocktail and wine are tied to the local beer relationship because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker.
